record.title: Unauthenticated POST /wake on qwenpaw-keepalive (WAKE_TOKEN unset) can force probes but cannot trigger an InstaBox API wake — INSTABOX_API_KEY is unset
record.description: WAKE_TOKEN is unset, so the optional gate at worker/src/index.js:205-208 is skipped and unauthenticated POST /wake reaches the probe (verified live: 200, status up, wake:null). However the high-impact arm is impossible in the deployed configuration: the Cloudflare Workers secrets list for qwenpaw-keepalive is empty (result []), so INSTABOX_API_KEY is unset, and the API-wake condition at line 211 (probe offline/waking AND INSTABOX_API_KEY AND INSTABOX_MACHINE_ID) can never be true; callInstaBoxWake (fetch at lines 150-153) is therefore unreachable from /wake and from the cron tick (line 166). The residual confirmed issue is low severity: anyone can POST /wake (and GET /ping, which has no auth check at all) to force a probe of the public QwenPaw URL — which by InstaBox design wakes a paused box on request — and to write KV status (source manual-wake), burning Worker/instance activity. If INSTABOX_API_KEY is ever set without WAKE_TOKEN, the unauthenticated API-wake arm becomes live immediately.

trace.what: POST /wake handler; no auth before this point
Optional gate only: if (env.WAKE_TOKEN) { check X-Wake-Token header or ?token, else 401 } — skipped entirely when WAKE_TOKEN unset
Unauthenticated request falls through to probeQwenPaw(env, {allowRetry:true}) — up to 2 attempts with 60s retry on 503/transient failure
API-wake condition: (result.status === 'offline' || 'waking') && env.INSTABOX_API_KEY && env.INSTABOX_MACHINE_ID — INSTABOX_API_KEY unset, so this is always false
10-minute gap check (WAKE_MIN_GAP_MS = 10*60_000, line 10) — unreachable while the line-211 condition is false
wake = await callInstaBoxWake(env) — unreachable in deployed config
callInstaBoxWake POSTs https://api.instabox.sh/v1/machines/<id>/wake with X-API-Key: env.INSTABOX_API_KEY (definition lines 147-160)
Cron keepAliveTick has the identical INSTABOX_API_KEY && INSTABOX_MACHINE_ID gate, so the cron API-wake fallback is also impossible while the key is unset
GET /ping has no token check at all (lines 198-202) — unauthenticated probe-forcing exists independently of /wake

record.conditions: Confirmed low while INSTABOX_API_KEY remains unset: unauthenticated /wake and /ping can force probes (and, via InstaBox's own wake-on-request for the public URL, indirectly wake a paused box) and write KV status, but cannot call the InstaBox API. The condition flips if the owner ever runs `wrangler secret put INSTABOX_API_KEY` without also setting WAKE_TOKEN — then an unauthenticated POST /wake during an offline/waking window, more than 10 min after the last API wake, would POST the InstaBox wake API with the stored key. Correction to the candidate: the sink call is at line 215 (condition line 211, gap line 214), not lines 212-216; callInstaBoxWake is defined at lines 147-160 with the fetch at lines 150-153.
record.remediation: Set WAKE_TOKEN as a Worker secret (wrangler secret put WAKE_TOKEN) and, if the API-wake fallback is ever wanted, set INSTABOX_API_KEY only together with WAKE_TOKEN. Side effects / correctness notes: (1) The activity-feed Worker's Wake button (features/infra/workers/activity-feed/index.js:85) POSTs /wake with no token and will start returning 401 — fix it server-side by storing WAKE_TOKEN as that Worker's own secret and forwarding it as X-Wake-Token, never embedding the token in client-side JS. (2) The Pages status page Wake button (pages/public/status-page.html:86-90) already calls /ping, not /wake, so it is unaffected by gating /wake — but /ping (lines 198-202) has no auth check at all, so gating only /wake leaves unauthenticated probe-forcing open; either gate /ping the same way (breaking the public status-page Wake button unless it is proxied server-side) or explicitly accept /ping as the intended public wake path and document it. (3) Do not put WAKE_TOKEN in wrangler.toml [vars] or any static Pages asset — it would be public.

local: Re-read worker/src/index.js lines 204-221 and 147-160 after any change; confirm the gate is unconditional (not `if (env.WAKE_TOKEN)`) if /ping is also gated, or document the /ping exception.
deployment: Unauthenticated POST /wake must return 401 {error:unauthorized}; the same POST with header X-Wake-Token set to the owner-held token must return 200 with wake:null while up.
Re-run the Cloudflare secrets list (names only) and confirm WAKE_TOKEN is present and INSTABOX_API_KEY is present only if the API fallback is intended.
Confirm the activity-feed Wake button still works after the change (server-side token forwarding) and the Pages status page Wake button behaviour is as intended (/ping path).
Do NOT force downtime to test the API-wake arm; wait for a natural offline/waking window and then check /status for lastWakeAt/lastWakeResult, or test with a throwaway machine id/key pair.
